goal: Maximize verification throughput without sacrificing correctness, isolation, reproducibility, or regression protection.
principles: Run the smallest relevant test set first.
Parallelize independent read-only tests and benchmark cases.
Cache immutable dependency/setup work when cache validity is proven.
Fail fast on deterministic configuration, import, syntax, or contract failures.
Expand from targeted tests to dependent suites only after the local gate passes.
Run full regression verification before promotion when shared code changes.
Never skip a required test solely to improve runtime.
Never weaken assertions, fixtures, thresholds, or acceptance criteria to obtain a pass.
Record timing, resource use, retries, flakes, and failures as evidence.
adaptive_concurrency: Increase concurrency only while workers remain independent and runner/resource health stays within configured limits; reduce concurrency on contention, instability, or excessive retries.
flake_policy: Retries may diagnose suspected flakes but cannot convert a failure into a pass without a clean required run and documented disposition.
benchmark_policy: Benchmark acceleration may parallelize independent cases, but before/after evidence and dependent-suite retesting remain mandatory for shared fixes.
public_pages: Expose safe aggregate timing, throughput, pass/fail, retry, flake, and regression metrics; exclude secrets and sensitive raw logs.
